traceability.notes:
All specified requirements for 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are implemented and verified: - Backtick-wrapped annotation keywords are stripped via /`[^`]*`/g and replaced with spaces of equal length before annotation detection (REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE, REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES). - Filtering is implemented centrally in normalizeCommentLine in valid-annotation-format-internal.ts and is used by the annotation validation logic, fulfilling REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER and IMPL-NORMALIZE-COMMENT. - Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts explicitly cover documentation-style patterns (e.g., "`@story` + `@req`"), ensure they do not produce detectable annotations, and verify that real annotations outside backticks are still detected. - Multiple backtick spans on the same line, and lines without backticks, are covered by tests; behavior is line-based, so multi-line comments are handled by applying the same normalization per line. - All Jest tests pass (npm test -- --verbose), demonstrating no regressions. - The behavior and rationale are documented in the normalizeCommentLine JSDoc, and the story file itself provides further explanation.
Given this concrete implementation and passing, story-specific tests, the story is fully satisfied.
